metaDescription: Order custom kraft awards recognition for eco-friendly employee appreciation. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Kraft awards recognition pieces offer a distinctive, eco-friendly alternative to traditional plaques and trophies. Made from recycled materials, these items appeal to companies prioritizing sustainability in their employee appreciation programs. The natural brown texture of kraft pairs well with foil stamping or screen printing for a polished, organic look. Whether you're honoring years of service or team achievements, kraft awards provide a unique, memorable presentation that aligns with green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom kraft awards recognition plaque with foil stamped text on recycled kraft paper, eco-friendly employee appreciation gift
